text:
sarah: Quick heads-up: mini-canary for raven-lite int4 is showing funcall parse failures up ~2.4x vs fp16 baseline. Repro steps + a failing snippet below.

kai: ugh. any example output? rough failure rate?

sarah: sample output (sanitized):
```
Request id: abc123
Model: raven-lite-int4
Prompt: call get_price(symbol="AAPL")
Model output: {"action": "call", "name": "get_price", "args": {"symbol": "AAPL"  
```
(note: missing closing `}` in args -> JSON parse error)

sarah: overall numbers from the 1k micro-run: parse_fail_rate=6.8% (int4), fp16 baseline=2.8%. Token-level diffs look small but suffixes more often truncated.

anita: hmm. did we change kvprefix packing for the canary? those shifts often push suffix tokens into different positions and can break strict schemas.

sarah: yep enabled aggressive kvprefix packing (80%) to hit higher throughput for the int4 canary.

mike: quick ideas: 1) run ablation int4 without kvprefix packing, 2) add a soft-json-wrap postprocess that attempts to close/open brackets and reparse, 3) add a targeted prompt suffix that forces explicit closing token.

kai: i'll add parse_failure_rate_by_prompt_type and a small histogram to the canary dashboard so we can split by tool invocation templates.

anita: agree on ablation. also check if tokenizer differences between quant kernels alter whitespace/controlchar emission (nonprinting unicode).

sarah: running ablation: int4-no-kvprefix now. kicking off small 2k sample run. @canary-bot start run int4-no-kvprefix

canary-bot: created run int4-no-kvprefix -> https://ci.redwood/runs/1758123456-int4-no-kvprefix :white_check_mark:

mike: if ablation shows parse_fail_rate drops back to ~fp16, then kvprefix packing is the likely culprit and we should prefer conservative packing for toolcall routes. fallback policy idea: if parse_fail_rate > 3.5% over 1h for a route, route toolcall traffic to fp16 variant automatically.

sarah: good call. I'll also diff tokenizer outputs and collect a few high-signal failure examples to paste here. will update thread when results in (~30-45m). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
